title: fix(auth): sign-out keeps the list layout for the same person; a change of user still clears it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBDHJBvzScLgkhKgms97sNuU)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhoBbwh8URjwQHde8v

Fixes #36110

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 控制台用户退出登录（或会话自行过期）后再以同一账号登录，列表的列宽、行高和视图标签顺序都还在；换另一个人在同一浏览器登录，仍然全部清空、回到视图默认。
- 落实维护者在列表布局只存浏览器这一裁决里的第一点：布局不再有服务器副本，退出登录不能再把它清掉。
- 出错的话，最坏是同一人退出后布局又被清空（与今天一样），或者存了布局以外的东西的条目被当作普通数据清掉；可以直接撤回本改动。
- 无。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/auth`: the sign-out tier (`purgeSignedOutUserClientState`, run on `signOut()` and on every session read that answers "no session", including the 401 re-check) now keeps two `localStorage` key families by prefix, the first prefix exception to the allowlist sweep: `list-layout:` (app-shell's list layout store: tab order, per-view widths and row height) and `grid-columns-` (the grid's own copy of column widths and order, read by a record page's related tab). An entry is kept **only while its value holds that layout and nothing more** (`holdsOnlyListLayout` / `holdsOnlyGridColumns`: view ids, field names, finite widths, one of the five spec row heights). Anything else under those prefixes (a filter, a search term, rows, unparsable text) is swept like any other key. `sessionStorage` is untouched by the exception.
- The change-of-user tier (`purgePreviousUserClientState`) is unchanged and keeps none of it.
- Both prefixes are spelled out in auth (it depends on neither app-shell nor plugin-grid), following the file's existing "held together by a behaviour test" pattern. `listLayoutStore.ts` and `objectGridColumnState.ts` get comment-only notes pointing at the exception.
- `ui/packages/auth/README.md` sign-out section, the P1 checklist item `identity-auth.console-sign-out-and-ended-session` (revision 4: title, acceptance[0], new acceptance[1], negative[1]/[2], steps), and one `@object-ui/auth` patch changeset.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/signOutKeepsListLayout-36110.test.tsx`: well-formed entries kept byte for byte; every row height kept; 13 not-only-layout values removed; sessionStorage copies removed; look-alike prefixes removed; change of user removes both families; a same-person re-adopt removes nothing.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/context/__tests__/signOutPurge.test.tsx` rewritten for the new behaviour. Both families are written by their **real writers** (`useObjectListLayout`; `ObjectGrid` resize + reorder), then: `signOut()` keeps them byte for byte; the same person signing back in gets the layout back through the hook; a "no session" read and a 401 re-check (sessions that end on their own) keep them; every `ROW_HEIGHT_TO_DENSITY_MODE` row height written through the writer survives; a different person signing in clears both families and opens at `{}`; with nobody signed in nothing is written. The shape pin therefore applies to what the writers store: a writer that adds a part loses its entry and these cases go red.

<details><summary>Runs and ablations</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/auth/ packages/app-shell/src/context/__tests__/signOutPurge.test.tsx`: 51 files, 530 passed and 2 failed: the two change-of-user cases in the pin, which failed on test isolation, not on the purge. After the fix (described under Acceptance notes) the pin passed 10/10 (`VERDICT command-exit 0`).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/auth --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: both `Done`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Ablation 1, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (`isKeptListLayoutEntry` dropped from the sign-out sweep): 13 failed / 17 passed across the two files, i.e. every "kept" case in both. Restored, blob == HEAD.
- Ablation 2 (value shape check replaced by `raw !== null`): the 13 "removes an entry holding …" cases failed. Restored, blob == HEAD.
- Tests resolve `@object-ui/auth` to `src` through the vitest alias, so no dist rebuild was needed for the ablations.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- What I measured, not assumed: tab order lives in `list-layout:` (`viewOrder`). The only browser-only layout families are `list-layout:` and `grid-columns-`. The grid copy also stores **column order** (`order`, field names) next to widths. The card's To-do 1 keeps that family as a whole, and the ruling's "object names, field names, widths and view ids" covers it, so the shape allows `order` there.
- The main list hands the grid a `columnState` (falls back to `{}`), so on the list page `grid-columns-` is written but never read. Only the related tab reads it. A related tab mounts after its record loads, which is after `AuthProvider`'s adopt effect has purged a previous owner's keys. So the kept copy is never read by a different person.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is red on `origin/main` itself, from an ABSENT SYMBOL anchor in `areas/access-security.json` (`anonymousFormExplicitWithdrawals`). This diff does not touch that area, and `identity-auth.json` passes.
- The app-shell pin plants `auth-session-user-id` in `beforeEach`, because `SessionUserScope` keeps its owner in memory across the cases of one file. The comment there explains why.

## Verification

Read first: (1) `ActiveOrganizationStorage.ts`, `holdsOnlyListLayout` / `isKeptListLayoutEntry` and the one-argument change in `purgeSignedOutUserClientState`; (2) `signOutPurge.test.tsx`, the grid writer cases; (3) the checklist item's acceptance[0].

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/context/__tests__/signOutPurge.test.tsx` should report 10 passed.
